q: Which is the longest river in the world by most measurements?
exp: The Nile (about 6,650 km) is traditionally the longest river in the world. Answer: Nile

q: Mount Everest lies on the border of which two countries?
exp: Mount Everest sits on the Nepal–China (Tibet) border. Answer: Nepal and China (Tibet)

q: Which is the largest ocean on Earth?
exp: The Pacific Ocean is the largest and deepest ocean. Answer: Pacific

q: The Sahara Desert is located on which continent?
exp: The Sahara Desert is in North Africa. Answer: Africa

q: Which country has the largest area in the world?
exp: Russia is the largest country by land area (about 17.1 million sq km). Answer: Russia

q: The Great Barrier Reef is located off the coast of which country?
exp: The Great Barrier Reef lies off the northeastern coast of Australia. Answer: Australia

q: Which strait separates Europe from Africa?
exp: The Strait of Gibraltar separates Spain (Europe) from Morocco (Africa). Answer: Strait of Gibraltar

q: The Amazon rainforest is primarily located in which continent?
exp: Most of the Amazon rainforest lies in Brazil, South America. Answer: South America

q: Which is the largest country in Africa by area?
exp: Algeria is the largest country in Africa by area. Answer: Algeria

q: The Antarctic Circle passes through which ocean only?
exp: The Antarctic Circle lies entirely within the Southern (Antarctic) Ocean. Answer: Southern (Antarctic)

q: Which is the largest island in the world (excluding continental landmasses)?
exp: Greenland is the world's largest island. Answer: Greenland

q: The Strait of Malacca lies between which two landmasses?
exp: The Strait of Malacca lies between the Malay Peninsula and the Indonesian island of Sumatra. Answer: Malaysia/Thailand and Indonesia (Sumatra)

q: Which desert is the largest hot desert in the world?
exp: The Sahara is the largest hot desert in the world (about 9.2 million sq km). Answer: Sahara

q: The Danube River flows through how many countries before reaching the Black Sea?
exp: The Danube flows through 10 countries, the most of any river in Europe. Answer: 10

q: Which line of latitude divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres?
exp: The Equator (0° latitude) divides the Earth into Northern and Southern Hemispheres. Answer: Equator
